title: 苹果携手LG布局智能家居新品
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: So interesting to read this one, and we'll bring the diagrams back up.
segments.zh: 这个话题很有意思，我们再把图表调出来。

segments.en: They're in your story, but Apple is partnering on this range of devices.
segments.zh: 你的报道里提到了，苹果正在合作推出一系列设备。

segments.en: Though I've been reporting for years now that Apple has several first party and how smart home devices coming. This is part of a gigantic reboot to its home strategy.
segments.zh: 尽管我多年来一直报道苹果将推出多款第一方智能家居设备，但这是其家居战略大规模重启的一部分。

segments.en: HomeKit launched in 2014 has been an unmitigated disaster, compared to what you're seeing from ring, from what you're seeing from Google,
segments.zh: 2014年推出的HomeKit相比Ring、Google等产品，表现一直不尽如人意。

segments.en: from what you're seeing from others. So Apple is starting over, and so they'll announce a new HomePod mini, a smart home hub with a display that's like an Amazon Echo show,
segments.zh: 所以苹果要重新开始，将发布新的HomePod mini、带显示屏的智能家居中枢（类似Amazon Echo Show），

segments.en: and a new Apple TV. But yesterday I revealed there's more. In addition to the flagship devices, Apple's basically coming out with what I'm calling a smart home starter kit.
segments.zh: 以及新的Apple TV。但昨天我透露还有更多。除了旗舰设备，苹果基本上还会推出我称之为智能家居入门套件的东西。

segments.en: If you're building a smart home, what would you want? You would want a smart lock, you'd want a smart thermostat, you'd want a smart doorbell, and you would want smart security cameras
segments.zh: 如果你在打造智能家居，你会想要什么？你会想要智能锁、智能恒温器、智能门铃，以及智能安防摄像头，

segments.en: inside, outside, and maybe a flood light camera. So they're coming out with all of that, and they're partnering with LG on it, according to my sources, and I searched to the FCC database
segments.zh: 室内、室外，也许还有泛光灯摄像头。据我的消息源，他们正在推出所有这些，并与LG合作，我还查了FCC数据库，

segments.en: and found that these LG branded devices are in midst of getting regulatory approval of the United States.
segments.zh: 发现这些LG品牌设备正在美国获取监管批准。

segments.en: Okay, so how unusual is the step for Apple to say go to another company and be like, you guys are good at this, and we're good at this, and we can work together. And then the big picture of why
segments.zh: 那么，苹果找另一家公司说‘你们擅长这个，我们擅长这个，我们可以合作’，这一步有多不寻常？以及背后的整体原因是什么？

segments.en: a lock and a doorbell and a thermostat works. We've got Apple's trying to do in the home.
segments.zh: 门锁、门铃和恒温器都能用。苹果正试图在智能家居领域有所作为。
